bestBets.overview: PRAGUE PRIDE comes to Queensland for the first time. She was placed in her last two Victorian races before coming north and if she brings that form, she can win this. OKAY ZOOMER has been racing in consistent form having been placed in his last couple. This no harder and can get away with this. ITS SHOWTIME is screaming out to win his maiden, although he has had 16 chances. Never far away and he should be in finish. DARK FAE showed good speed to sit forward here last start and held on bravely beaten less than a length. Third-up and ready to find best.
